files.name: motion-prompt-077.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Horizontal scroll" (横スクロール), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #077

What it is: Scrolling down moves the content sideways
What the sample shows: As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.
Spec:
- Scroll: 0→420 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 420→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
- The heading "WORKS" scrolls away; the section reaches the top at 40 px of scroll and stays there.
- Cards: four at 200 × 112, gap 20, side padding 34. Horizontal travel = 34·2 + 200·4 + 20·3 − 511 = 417 px.
- Card x = start x − p × 417, with p = (scroll − 40) / 380: linear in scroll, no easing.
- The scrollbar thumb moves down while the cards move sideways.
When to use it: Use it to show work, case studies or products in a row inside a long vertical page.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/077.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
